title: 第19章 周围领主的动作第20章 嚣张的石溪领
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
一个星期后，黑麦屯的重建已近尾声。
新砌的砖墙比原来还高半尺，木屋的框架立了起来，农奴们忙着往屋顶铺茅草。
罗恩站在屯子口，看着来来往往的人群，点了点头。
佩林在旁边汇报：“大人，再有三天就能全部完工。人手从其他屯撤回去，不耽误农活。”
“嗯。”罗恩应了一声，转身往回走。
路上，佩林又说起盐场的事：
“盐矿目前已经达到最大产量，在扩大的话人手就不够用了。”
罗恩没接话，只是摆了摆手。佩林识趣地闭嘴。
目前领地的发展已经步入正轨，想要在高速发展，除非在发现一个富矿，不然没有金币，罗恩也想不到好办法。
“大人，盐矿那边又发现有人晃悠。”格雷道。
“这回不是一两个，是七八个，穿着杂色衣服，像是佣兵。”
罗恩心里一动：“这次抓到人没有？”
“没有，就在林子边缘转悠，待了半天又走了。”格雷道。
“要不要派骑士跟上去看看？”
罗恩想了想：“不用，骑士还是不要分开行动，让巡逻队盯紧点就行。”
格雷应了一声，正要退下，哈特从外面匆匆进来。
“大人，绿湖领来人了。”
来的是个四十来岁的中年男人，自称是奥斯汀男爵的管事。他带了两车货物，说是奥斯汀男爵听说河湾领遭了灾，特意送点东西慰问。
罗恩让人把东西收了，请管事坐下喝茶。
“奥斯汀男爵有心了。”罗恩道。

“这点小事还劳烦管事跑一趟。”
管事笑了笑：“男爵大人说，咱们两家是邻居，又都跟临水领不太对付，理应多走动。”
他顿了顿，压低声音：
“大人，我这次来，还有一件事，男爵大人让我提醒您，最近临水领那边有人在周边几个领主那里走动，散布了些关于河湾领盐矿的消息。”
罗恩神色不变：“哦？说了什么？”
“就说您这盐矿产量不小，质量也不错，每年收入几千枚金币。”
“玛德，怪不得领地里这几天多了那么多探子。”
管事看着他：
“男爵大人说，这种话传出去，肯定会有人动心思，让您多留个心眼。
要是大人您应付不过来，咱们两家是邻居，有困难可以找绿湖领帮忙。”
罗恩点点头：“替我谢过奥斯汀男爵。”
待管事离去，罗恩面色如霜。
content_en:
A week later, the reconstruction of Black Maitton was nearing completion.
The newly built brick wall was half a foot higher than the original, the frame of the wooden house was erected, and the serfs were busy laying thatch on the roof.
Ron stood at the entrance of the village, looking at the people coming and going, and nodded.
Perrin reported from the side: "Sir, it will be completed in three days. Manpower will be withdrawn from other villages so that the farm work will not be delayed."
"Yeah." Ron responded, turned around and walked back.
On the way, Palin talked about the salt farm again:
"The salt mine has reached its maximum production, and if it expands, there will not be enough manpower."
Ron didn't answer, just waved his hand. Perrin wisely shut up.
At present, the development of the territory is on the right track. If you want to develop at a high speed, unless you discover a rich mine, there will be no gold coins, and Ron can't think of a good way.
"Sir, we found someone wandering around the salt mine again," Gray said.
"This time it's not one or two, but seven or eight, wearing colorful clothes, like mercenaries."
Ron's heart moved: "Have you caught anyone this time?"
"No, I just wandered around the edge of the forest. I stayed there for a long time and then left." Gray said.
"Would you like to send a knight to follow us and take a look?"
Ron thought for a moment: "No, it's better for the knights not to separate and let the patrols keep an eye on them."
Gray responded and was about to retreat when Hart hurried in from outside.
"Sir, Green Lake has brought people."
A middle-aged man in his forties came, claiming to be Baron Austin's steward. He brought two carts of goods with him, saying that Baron Austin heard that the Reach Territory had suffered a disaster and specially sent something to express his condolences.
Ron asked the steward to put away the things and asked the steward to sit down and drink tea.
"Baron Austin is interested." Ron said.
"It's such a small thing that I'd rather bother the steward to make a trip."
The steward smiled and said, "The Baron said that our two families are neighbors, and since we don't get along well with the Linshui Territory, we should move around more."
He paused and lowered his voice:
"Sir, there is one more thing I have come to do this time. The Baron asked me to remind you that someone in the Waterfront Territory has recently been walking around with several surrounding lords, spreading some news about the Salt Mine in the River Bend Territory."
Ron's expression remained unchanged: "Oh? What did you say?"
"Let's just say that the output of your salt mine is not small and the quality is good. It earns several thousand gold coins every year."
"Made, no wonder there are so many spies in the territory these days."
The steward looked at him:
"My Lord Baron said that if word like this spreads, someone will definitely be interested in it and ask you to be more careful.
If you, sir, can't handle it, our two families are neighbors. If you have any difficulties, you can ask Green Lake Leader for help. "
Ron nodded: "Thank Baron Austin for me."
When the steward left, Ron's face turned frosty.
